 Sub-Freezing Temperatures Expected For Parts Of Chicago Area
 While there might be freezing temps Friday night, the first snowflakes of the season haven't yet arrived.
 Andrea Earnest , Patch Staff 
 Posted Fri, Nov 6, 2026 at 10:31 am CT | Updated Fri, Nov 6, 2026 at 11:35 am CT Sub-freezing temperatures may happen for parts of central and northern Illinois for the first time this season, according to the National Weather Service Chicago. 
 The high for Friday is 50 degrees, and lows on Friday night could be as cold as 28 degrees. The "widespread freeze" is expected away from Lake Michigan and west of Interstate 57.
 The weekend will also be cooler with a high of 52 on Saturday, and 62 on Sunday, according to the current forecast.

 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . "Temperatures then warm back into the 60s early next week," the weather service said.
 While we will get a brief cool-down for the weekend, it doesn't look like we will see the first snowflakes of the season. Chicago's "normal" first day for a trace of snow is Oct. 31, so we have passed that this year. The latest first date happened in 1999, when our first trace of snow didn't fall until Dec. 5, according to weather service data.

 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . Here is a more detailed look at the weather for this weekend for the Joliet area, per the weather service:
 FRIDAY: Increasing clouds, with a high near 48. North northwest wind 10 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph.
 FRIDAY NIGHT: Partly cloudy, with a low around 32. North northwest wind 5 to 10 mph, with gusts as high as 15 mph.
 SATURDAY: Mostly sunny, with a high near 50. Northwest wind around 5 mph becoming west southwest in the afternoon. Winds could gust as high as 10 mph.
 SATURDAY NIGHT: Mostly clear, with a low around 35. West southwest wind 5 to 10 mph, with gusts as high as 15 mph.
 SUNDAY: Sunny, with a high near 59. West wind around 10 mph, with gusts as high as 20 mph.
 SUNDAY NIGHT: Mostly clear, with a low around 36.
